lines.zh: 箭矢掠过耳旁，留下寒意。
lines.en: Arrows whiz past, chilling the ears.
Taut bowstring, icy breeze.

lines.zh: 漆黑长发随风飘，弓箭手无声。
lines.en: Black hair flows, silent archer.

lines.zh: 弓箭手步伐轻盈，夜风中隐匿。
lines.en: Archery steps lightly, in the night breeze.
Icy shards crunch beneath the feet.

lines.zh: 寒风中，弓箭手的呼吸可见。
lines.en: Breath visible in the icy wind.
Black arrows, silent approach.

lines.zh: 寒冷夜空下，弓箭手悄无息。
lines.en: Silent in the cold, night sky.

lines.zh: 寒风中，弓箭手轻盈如影。
lines.en: Silent, archer glides like a shadow.

lines.zh: 寒冰碎片在黑夜中闪烁。
lines.en: Icy shards glimmer in the night.
My quiver clicks on the frozen soil.

lines.zh: 雪地上只留下浅浅的足印。
lines.en: Only shallow prints remain on the snow.

lines.zh: 寒风中的独行者，无声无息。
lines.en: Silent wanderer in the cold.
Silent in the cold night, archer.
Steady in the dark, archer.
Silent in the cold night.
Steady in the cold.
Silent in the cold wind.
Steady in the cold, wind.
Silent in the archer's cold night.
Silent in the cold wind, archer.

lines.zh: 寒夜中的静止，冰冷的弓箭手。
lines.en: Silent in the cold night, icy archer.

lines.zh: 我数着箭袋里剩下的箭。
lines.en: I count the arrows left in my quiver.

lines.zh: 呼出的白气在弓上结霜。
lines.en: My breath frosts over the bow.
The string is slack; my eyes are not.
I lean on a frozen tree and wait for dark.
Gaze locked, chill rises.
Gaze through the dark, aim.

lines.zh: 寒光中，弓箭手目光锐利。
lines.en: Sharp gaze in the cold light.
Gaze like a cold wind, aim.
Gaze through the night.

lines.zh: 寒夜中，弓箭手目光冷冽。
lines.en: Gaze icy in the cold night.
Gaze through the dark, aim.

lines.zh: 寒风中，弓箭手目光坚定。
lines.en: Gaze steady in the cold wind.
Gaze like icy cold.
Gaze fixed, icy threat.
My arrowhead already points at you.
You have entered my range.

lines.zh: 我看见你抬手，慢了半拍。
lines.en: I saw your hand rise half a beat late.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在冷空气里太明显。
lines.en: Your breath is too visible in the cold.
My eyes are brighter than the snow.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枯枝替我报了信。
lines.en: The twig you snapped announced you.
Stand still, I am measuring.

lines.zh: 你身后那棵树，挡不住箭。
lines.en: That tree behind you won't stop an arrow.
An arrow hit my chest!
The ice shards didn't shield me.
My body is trembling...
Cold seeps into my bones...
I start to shake...

lines.zh: 寒冰碎片从我箭袋里滑落。
lines.en: Ice shards slip from my quiver.
I'm not as firm...
My pale hands can no longer hold the bow.
I start to fall...
I feel pain...

lines.zh: 寒风中，弓弦轻响，你被射中了！
lines.en: In the cold wind, a bowstring twangs, and you're hit!

lines.zh: 别靠近，否则我会射穿你！
lines.en: Don't come closer, or I'll pierce you!

lines.zh: 小心，我的箭能冻结你的呼吸！
lines.en: Watch out, my arrows freeze your breath!

lines.zh: 你闻到我的箭矢的味道了吗？
lines.en: Can you smell my arrows?

lines.zh: 你看起来像个猎物，很适合我的弓箭！
lines.en: You look like prey, perfect for my bow!

lines.zh: 我的箭比你想象的更冷、更准！
lines.en: My arrows are colder and more accurate than you think!

lines.zh: 别试图接近我，否则你会变成冰雕！
lines.en: Stay away from me, or you'll become an ice statue!

lines.zh: 你身上的寒意是从我这里来的！
lines.en: The chill in you came from me!

lines.zh: 我的弓箭比黑夜更可怕！
lines.en: My bow is more terrifying than the night!

lines.zh: 你的皮甲无法阻止我的寒冰箭！
lines.en: Your leather armor can't stop my frost arrows!

lines.zh: 箭矢在空中交缠，你被击中了！
lines.en: Arrows weave in mid-air, and you're hit!

lines.zh: 你的身体撞上了我的箭矢！
lines.en: Your body collided with my arrows!

lines.zh: 你撞上了我的箭矢，无法躲避！
lines.en: You collided with my arrows, with no escape!

lines.zh: 我的弓箭交织，你无法逃脱！
lines.en: My arrows entwine, leaving no escape!

lines.zh: 箭矢密集如雨，你无法躲避！
lines.en: Arrows rain down, leaving no escape!

lines.zh: 你的身体撞上了我的箭群！
lines.en: Your body collided with my arrow swarm!

lines.zh: 我的箭矢像幽灵一样接近你！
lines.en: My arrows approach like ghosts!
You are surrounded by my arrows!

lines.zh: 你的盔甲无法阻挡我的箭矢！
lines.en: Your armor can't stop my arrows!
Arrows rain down, leaving no escape!

lines.zh: 你无法阻止我和我的伴侣！
lines.en: You can't stop me and my mate!

lines.zh: 我们是永不分离的伴侣！
lines.en: We are never apart, partners!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣和我一起狩猎！
lines.en: My mate hunts with me!

lines.zh: 你挡在了我和我的伴侣之间！
lines.en: You're in the way of me and my mate!

lines.zh: 我和我的伴侣总是联手作战！
lines.en: My mate and I always fight together!
My mate protects me!

lines.zh: 你阻止不了我和我的伴侣！
lines.en: You can't stop me and my mate!

lines.zh: 我和我的伴侣一起狩猎！
lines.en: My mate and I hunt together!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣和我共享猎物！
lines.en: My mate and I share our prey!

lines.zh: 你无法阻止我和我的伴侣分开！
lines.en: You can't separate me and my mate!
Frost encases my form.
I stand resolute in the chill.
This frozen expanse is mine.
The cold makes me stronger.
My arrows never feel warmth.
Ice shards mark my presence.
My prey's cry awakens me.

lines.zh: 霜冻在我的双眼中闪烁。
lines.en: Frost twinkles in my eyes.
I hunt for survival.
Ice seals each of my breaths.
My arrow is aimed.
My prey is in sight.
I am keen in the dark.
Waiting is the hunter's art.

lines.zh: 寒冷使我的行动更敏捷。
lines.en: The cold makes me swift.
My prey's scent guides me.
I close in silently.
My prey's breath trembles.
The silent hunt begins.
I am frozen in patience.
The bow is up.

lines.zh: 你的轮廓进了我的准星。
lines.en: Your outline enters my sight.
The wind is on my side.
Fletching brushes my cheek.

lines.zh: 你成了这片雪地唯一的目标。
lines.en: You are the only target on this snow.
I drew full; you heard nothing.
Aim and shoot.

lines.zh: 我的箭矢从不偏离目标。
lines.en: My arrow never misses.

lines.zh: 寒风中我的箭矢更精准。
lines.en: My arrow is more precise in the cold.
My bow never misses.
One shot, one kill.
My prey trembles; my arrow shoots.
Aim, and strike to kill.

lines.zh: 寒冰碎片是猎杀的果实。
lines.en: Ice shards are the fruits of my hunt.
My arrow is never wasted.
Two through one, and the prey falls.
I release, and the arrow flies.
Your chest sits at the string's center.
I wait for the instant you turn.
An inch off is still off.
An ice arrow needs no second shot.
My breath stops before the shot.
Frost on the string creaks as I draw.

lines.zh: 你现在只剩一个动作的时间。
lines.en: You have time for one more move.

lines.zh: 寒风刺骨，箭矢无声穿透你的皮肤。
lines.en: Chilled to the bone, arrows pierce without sound.

lines.zh: 苍白之刃在月光下闪烁，寒意侵骨。
lines.en: Pale blades gleam under moonlight, chilling to the bone.

lines.zh: 弓弦如月，箭矢如影，命中即死。
lines.en: Moonlike bowstring, shadowy arrows, fatal hits.

lines.zh: 弓箭如鬼魅般穿梭，无声无息。
lines.en: Arrows dart like ghosts, silently.

lines.zh: 苍白的身影在夜色中显现，致命一击。
lines.en: Pale forms appear in the night, delivering lethal blows.

lines.zh: 寒冰碎片划破肌肤，剧痛难忍。
lines.en: Ice shards slice skin, causing intense pain.

lines.zh: 月光下，弓箭手无声隐去。
lines.en: Under moonlight, the archer fades without a sound.

lines.zh: 弓弦紧绷，月光下如夜色中的利刃。
lines.en: Taut bowstring, a blade in the night moonlight.

lines.zh: 寒风中，弓箭手无声靠近。
lines.en: In the cold wind, the archer approaches without sound.

lines.zh: 寒冰碎片飞舞，寒气扑面。
lines.en: Ice shards fly, chilling the face.
The arrow slips through your shoulder seam!
An arrow pins your cloak!
Ice grazes and opens flesh!
My arrow is faster than your turn!
The second arrow is already loosed!
Ice shards spray into your eyes!

lines.zh: 苍白之影在月光下浮现。
lines.en: Pale shadows appear under moonlight.

lines.zh: 寒风中，弓箭手的影子浮现。
lines.en: Pale shadows appear in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 月光下的寒冰碎片闪耀。
lines.en: Moonlit ice shards glitter.
Archer appears in the cold night.
Pale shadows wander in the forest.

lines.zh: 寒风中，苍白的身影出现。
lines.en: Pale forms appear in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 月光下，弓箭手的轮廓显现。
lines.en: Archer's outline appears under moonlight.

lines.zh: 寒夜中，弓箭手悄然现身。
lines.en: Archer appears silently in the cold night.
Pale shadows drift in the wind.

lines.zh: 月光下的寒冰碎片闪烁。
lines.en: Moonlit ice shards shine.
A pale shape joins the snowfield.
I step out of the ice mist.
A bowstring sounds in the cold night.
Quiver full, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 冻原尽头站着一个人影。
lines.en: A figure stands at the tundra's edge.
Ice crystals gather into a path.
The white-haired hunter has arrived.
In the cold night, I open my eyes.
Arrows of ice melt at the first flame.
I fell from a height!
I'm drowning in icy water!
An explosion hurt me!
A projectile hit me!
A spell hit me!
I'm starving...
The lightning burned through my icy string.
I fell into the void...
